gate_sequence.rationale: Phase 5R research/model infrastructure is published PASS; bounded tabular projection with hash/schema identity is the first GridIQ-inspired capability.
Research UI v1 is operational; Zod-validated endpoints and React Query hooks extend the existing partial alignment without adopting Axios or browser token storage.
Provider-neutral inference ADR is accepted; conversation persistence and token provenance may be reimplemented only behind the inference boundary with no Gemini coupling.
Recharts bar/line panels for attention, squeeze, walk-forward, and risk summaries with provenance labels and accessibility fallbacks; Lightweight Charts remains canonical for OHLCV.
Bounded in-memory projection cache with byte and entry eviction, corrupt-entry rejection, and replay feature caching; precision policy records float32 round-trip semantics.

summary: GridIQ PORT_ADAPT work is sequenced: Phase 5R dataset reader first, UI-001 client/hooks second, ADR-LLM-001 assistant audit third, UI-001 Recharts research panels fourth, Phase 5R bounded memory cache fifth. Gemini invocation, browser token storage, and bundled gridiq.db remain DO_NOT_USE.
